versions.content: If the swCalibrationAccess of a VariableDataPrototype used in an NvDataInterface of a non volatile data port of a SwComponentPro- totype is set to readOnly or readWrite the RTE generator has to provide one reference to a location in memory where the actual content of the instance specific data of the corresponding VariableDataPrototype of the communication can be accessed.
